plan.notes:
Source: official University of Oklahoma undergraduate catalog (courseleaf), 'Computer Science, B.S.' page, 'Suggested Semester Plan of Study' grid — the genuine official term-by-term sequence for the Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Gallogly College of Engineering. Page footer reads 'Updated for 2026-2027 by The University of Oklahoma'. Transcribed 2026-09-30 by hand from the catalog page's plan-of-study grid. Course titles, credit hours, and prerequisites verified against the same catalog's official course descriptions (C S and MATH course pages, crawled 2026). Credit-resolution caveat: the official plan has two variable slots — the freshman intro-programming choice (CS 1323=3 / CS 1321=1 / CS 1324=4 credits) and a 0-3-hour sophomore open elective; footnote 3 states open electives bring the degree total to 120-121. This transcription pins the intro choice to CS 1323 (3 cr) and the sophomore open elective to 1 cr, so the plan sums to exactly 120 (semester ranges still match the official 14-17 and 15-18 ranges). Students choosing CS 1321/CS 1324 or more open-elective hours must rebalance to reach 120. Blank-grid-row caveat: the catalog grid renders some elective rows without labels; rows carrying footnote 4 (University-Wide General Education Approved Course List) are modeled as approved Gen Ed electives, footnote 3 rows as open electives, footnote 5 rows as Natural Science (Core II) electives, and the unlabeled junior/senior rows as approved CS electives (12 hours total per the catalog's Major Requirements). The catalog requires a grade of C or better in every curriculum course including prerequisites, and two college-level courses in a single world language (waivable with 2 years of high-school language).
Placement/external prereq details: MATH 1503 (or placement into higher mathematics; catalog prerequisite for CS 1321/CS 1323/CS 1324, CS 2334, CS 2813, CS 3203) | MATH 1823 (grade of C or better, or a satisfactory score on the OU math assessment; catalog prerequisite for MATH 1914)
